decisions.reason: The organic salami platter has stayed on the website for two years and fits the strategic push into organic lines, and keeping it costs little on existing slicing and packaging lines, so the option stays open despite low visibility.
The premium sharing snack is being extended with new Classic and poultry variants, which signals that uncertainty has resolved favorably and justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
Launched in 2024 and promoted on its own page, the organic boiled pork sausage is still too new for its value to be known, and holding it is cheap given the existing sausage know-how.
The organic thinly sliced chicken breast was just launched in two flavors and its prospects remain uncertain, so keeping this low-cost option open is preferable until sales data reveal more.

The organic herb-coated salami is a recent, close-to-core extension with low holding cost, so it stays on the market while its retail performance is still unresolved, though it may be culled later like the poultry mini snacks were.
